- Time: \(O(K N log N)\)
- Memory: \(O(K N)\)

N is the number of pixels and K the number of directions. The directional tree has K - 1 banks for each band, and each bank runs two FFT filters on the full band. Each subband is kept on the grid of its band, with zeros off its lattice. The bands shrink by 4 per level, so the finest band costs the most.
